concerns.text: The specification references a functional requirement FR‑012 (Shapiro‑Wilk normality test) in the unresolved concerns, but FR‑012 is not defined in the Functional Requirements list, creating a missing requirement.
FR‑001 cites “See US‑1” as a cross‑reference, but the document defines the user stories as “User Story 1” (not US‑1). This ambiguous identifier may prevent traceability.
The document alternates between the terms “User Story” and the shorthand “US‑1/US‑2”, leading to unstable terminology for the same concept.
